title: Undercurrents Surging
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Ji decided to take the initiative and set a trap to draw out the snake, that prying gaze mysteriously vanished the moment he closed the net—the other party seemed to have already anticipated his actions.

text.content: The night wind carried the sound of pine waves across the cliff edge, Chen Ji's fingertips hovering at the edge of that blurry foresight image. The full picture of the Holy Sect's plan had taken shape in his mind, except for that chaotic and unclear image disturbed by Chen Nian, like a thorn embedded in his heart, making him toss and turn unable to sleep. 'If the cost of saving Nian'er is releasing an existence that even the Eyes of Heavenly Dao fear...' He murmured in his heart, though a self-mocking curve twisted onto his lips. His knuckles tapped lightly against the stone table, the rhythm steady like placing a chess piece.

dialogue.content: 'What has you so absorbed in thought?' A cold female voice rang out from behind, accompanied by a faint scent of blood. Chen Ji didn't need to turn around to know who it was—Ye Qing, the Holy Maiden of the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path, was approaching under the moonlight, her crimson gown fluttering in the night wind like a burning karmic fire.

Chen Ji slowly turned around, his gaze calm as an ancient well: 'Thinking about a question I暂时没有答案的问题.' His tone was indifferent, as if discussing the weather today, 'Holy Maiden's late-night visit surely isn't to enjoy the moonlight.'

Ye Qing raised an eyebrow, her slender fingers toying with a strand of blue silk: 'Of course not.' She lowered her voice, a solemnity flickering across her brow, 'News from the Holy Sect—the seal on the Heavenly Fate Key is loosening. We don't have much time, Chen Ji.'

text.content: Before she finished speaking, Chen Ji's gaze suddenly turned sharp. He raised a hand to stop Ye Qing from continuing, his eyes sweeping like a hawk towards the漆黑 dense forest on the east side of the cliff. The pine wave sounds seemed to surge at the same moment, as if someone was whispering in the darkness. His knuckles tightened slightly, an inexplicable alertness racing from his tailbone to the back of his head—someone was watching.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing followed his gaze, her pupils slightly contracting. She calmly stepped back half a pace, standing shoulder to shoulder with Chen Ji, her voice extremely low: 'You sensed it?' Her fingers quietly formed a technique, demonic energy beginning to flow around her, ready to strike at any moment.

'Don't move.' Chen Ji's voice was light as a sigh, 'The other party comes with ill intent, and those with good intent don't come. Acting rashly will only alert the prey.' His lips were almost against Ye Qing's ear, his breath warm, 'And... I need to first figure out which side this unexpected visitor belongs to.'

text.content: Ye Qing's body stiffened slightly, clearly unaccustomed to such close contact. But she quickly suppressed the strangeness, obediently收敛了气息. Moonlight fell, illuminating the two standing side by side. In the shadows, an intangible gaze始终锁定着这边, like a snake's forked tongue, icy and piercing.

dialogue.content: 'The eyes within the alliance are more arrogant than we imagined.' Ye Qing's voice was cold as ice, 'I told you long ago, there are people in the alliance who shouldn't be there. Those 'waste disciples' of yours might one day bite you.' Her words were profound, clearly with ulterior meaning.

Upon hearing this, Chen Ji's lips反而弯起一个莫测的弧度. He raised his hand to brush a strand of hair blown乱 by the wind from Ye Qing's temple, the gesture intimate like comforting a frightened cub: 'Holy Maiden rest assured, since I dare to meet here at the cliff, I naturally have the把握 to let certain people see what I愿意让他们看见.'

text.content: His fingers gently tapped Ye Qing's shoulder—that was the predetermined signal they had agreed on—proceed as planned. In the next instant, Chen Ji's voice suddenly rose, carrying a lazy worldly unconcern: 'Since Holy Maiden is here, why not accompany Chen to enjoy this moonlight? Life as废物 in Tianqing Sect is truly boring,难得有人愿意听我说几句废话.'

dialogue.content: Ye Qing愣了一下，随即明白了他的意图. She cooperatively covered her lips and轻笑, her eyebrows revealing a trace of coquetry: 'Chen Gongzi has such兴致, however...' Her gaze intentionally or unintentionally swept across that dense forest, 'I wonder how many of your so-called 'nonsense' are true?'

text.content: The gaze in the shadows seemed even more substantial, Chen Ji could almost feel the urgency and greed contained within that窥探. He冷笑 in his heart—上钩了. The other party was急于确认他和魔道圣女的关系, then let them confirm个够. After all, the real plan was never on the surface.

choice.prompt: The watcher in the shadows is waiting to catch a flaw, how should Chen Ji deal with this potential threat?

choices.description: Secretly mobilize resources, follow the trail to find the watcher's identity, and nip the risk of intelligence leakage at the source.
choices.visible_cost: Consumes time and energy, may alert the enemy
choices.visible_reward: Uncover traitors within the alliance, eliminate hidden dangers
choices.risk_hint: The other party's background is unclear, rash investigation may backfire

text.content: Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, his pupils reflecting that幽暗 dense forest. A blurry figure flashed within it—thin and gaunt, but the gait carried a familiar rhythm. His heart stirred, this gait...似乎在哪里见过.

dialogue.content: 'Interesting.' He低声道, the curve of his lips带着几分玩味, 'Ye Qing, help me investigate one person—disciples who frequently enter the scripture archive recently, especially those who seem to have no交集 with me yet always appear at critical moments.'

choices.description: Pretend not to notice abnormalities, feed the watcher with false intelligence, turning the traitor into a tool for disseminating misinformation.
choices.visible_cost: Intelligence continues to leak, rescue plan risk increases
choices.visible_reward: Turn the tables, use the traitor to spread false intelligence
choices.risk_hint: If the watcher senses the intention early, they may set up a counter-trap

text.content: Chen Ji收回目光,重新望向夜清, his voice carrying appropriate轻佻: 'Since someone enjoys listening to stories, let them hear个够.' His fingertip drew a mark on the stone table—that was a rune only Ye Qing could understand—reverse bait.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's eyes gleamed, then concealed that fleeting appreciation. She stepped forward, her slender finger lightly touching Chen Ji's chest, her voice柔得能滴出水: 'Chen Gongzi, you are truly... an interesting person.'

text.content: No matter which path is chosen, that gaze in the shadows始终如影随形. Chen Ji's heart弦绷得更紧了—this watcher's patience exceeds expectations,绝非普通眼线. If this person cannot be quickly uncovered, the plan to rescue Chen Nian will collapse from within.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing suddenly leaned close to Chen Ji's ear, her breath幽冷: 'My Holy Sect has a secret technique that can track the residual aura of窥探者. If you trust me, within three days I will give you an answer.' Her tone rare地认真起来, 'But you must tell me, what exactly have you discovered?'

text.content: Under the moonlight, Chen Ji's face was half bright, half dark. He沉思片刻, finally spoke, his voice low as自言自语: 'I suspect... the watcher is not alone.' He raised his hand, pointing to three inconspicuous shadows in the dense forest, 'A moment ago, three auras took turns appearing,似乎在互相掩护. This手法,绝非寻常弟子能为.'

Ye Qing's expression changed slightly. She followed Chen Ji's finger to look, and even with her cultivation, she could only sense one of the auras. 'You mean...' Her voice有些发紧, 'Within Tianqing Sect, someone has formed an intelligence network,专门针对你?'

choice.prompt: The existence of an intelligence network complicates the situation further, Chen Ji must make a decision.

choices.description: Since the other party has formed a network, might as well turn the tables—create false intelligence to make the insiders suspect each other, collapsing the network from within.
choices.visible_cost: Requires meticulous planning, drains mental energy
choices.visible_reward: Eliminate all in one go, thoroughly clear internal hidden dangers
choices.risk_hint: If the layout has flaws, could lose everything

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly laughed, that smile显得格外清冷 under the moonlight. He took out a jade slip from his sleeve, crushing it to powder before Ye Qing: 'Since they want intelligence, I will give them a '大礼'.'

dialogue.content: 'In three days, I will intentionally leak a fake rescue date.' Chen Ji's eyes闪烁着算计的光芒, 'Let them compete to send this 'intelligence' out—then we follow the trail, to see whose vine this melon grows on.'

choices.description: Continue to pretend ignorance, let the other party relax their guard, wait for them to reveal greater flaws.
choices.visible_cost: Intelligence continues to leak during this period
choices.visible_reward: The other party may reveal more fatal mistakes
choices.risk_hint: The other party may strike first

text.content: 'Not urgent.' Chen Ji shook his head, his voice透着一种奇异从容, 'The most vulnerable moment for prey is not when it's first targeted, but when it thinks it has succeeded.'

dialogue.content: Ye Qing gazed at him, a complex emotion flickering in her eyes. This seemingly废物 man, his thoughts竟深沉如渊. 'Fine.' She轻轻颔首, 'I will wait with you. But if they strike first, I will protect you.'

text.content: The night wind grew cool, that窥探的目光 finally retreated slowly. Chen Ji望着密林深处, his eyes深沉如墨. He knew, this was merely the calm before the storm. Within three days, a暗网 set up against him will collide正面 with the chess game he亲手编织. Who is the hunter, who is the prey? The answer, will soon be revealed.
